newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL JUNE INDUSTRY OUTPUT UP 2.1 PCT - IBGE.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL JUNE INDUSTRY OUTPUT UP 2.1 PCT - IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian industrial production in June rose 2.1 percent from May, and increased 9.9 percent in comparison with June last year, the government's National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.

"The sector's good performance in June comes as a surprise, particularly when compared with the previous month, because it comes at a time when there are signs that consumption is less dynamic," the IBGE said in a statement.
Industrial production in the first half of 1997 grew 5.95 percent, while in the last 12 months output rose 6.8 percent, the IBGE said.
Output of capital goods saw the largest increase in June, rising 13.5 percent from May, the largest increase since August 1995, the IBGE said.

Production of durable goods also saw a significant rise, up 9.4 percent, given the good performance of the car industry. Output of non-durable goods and intermediate goods also increased, up 3.6 and 1.1 percent from May, respectively.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
